record.question: For a patient starting antiretroviral therapy (ART) for AIDS, what is the most important counselling point to emphasize to prevent drug resistance?
options: Taking medications only when feeling ill to avoid unnecessary daily burden.
Switching regimens frequently based on personal preference to minimize side effects.
Strict daily adherence to the full regimen as prescribed, without missing doses
Combining ART with herbal supplements to enhance efficacy
record.explanation: Answer C: Strict daily adherence to the full regimen as prescribed, without missing doses. Consistent daily adherence to the full antiretroviral regimen helps maintain viral suppression and reduce risk of resistance. Reference: https://clinicalinfo.hiv.gov/en/guidelines. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
